definitions.explanation: A strong feeling of longing or admiration for someone, something, or a way of life that one finds ideal or desirable. Implies looking up to something as an aspiration rather than feeling envious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{憧|あこが}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have a longing for life overseas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{憧|あこが}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧だ。
examples.english: She has been someone I've admired since childhood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{憧|あこが}れだった⟦パリ→パリ：25088_pari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、ついに⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I was finally able to visit Paris, which had been a long-held dream of mine.

notes:
{憧|あこが}れ is the noun form of the verb {憧|あこが}れる (to long for, to admire).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {憧|あこが}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～: the ～ one admires/longs for (e.g., {憧|あこが}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ = the person one admires)
- ～⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{憧|あこが}れ: longing for ～
- {憧|あこが}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧: to harbor an aspiration

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {憧|あこが}れ: admiring longing, aspiration (positive, looking up)
- ⟦{恋|こい}しい→恋しい：03055_koishii⟧: yearning for someone (romantic or nostalgic)
- ⟦{羨|うらや}ましい→羨ましい：02336_urayamashii⟧: envious (wanting what others have)
- ⟦{望|のぞ}み→望み：03543_nozomi⟧: hope, wish (more concrete or achievable)

USAGE:
{憧|あこが}れ is always positive — it expresses admiration without jealousy or resentment. The object of {憧|あこが}れ is seen as an ideal to aspire toward.
